Vik asked whether richer graph context reduces future tool calls and said to pause before further work. The explanation established that the binding trials capture all calls within each lookup turn, but not context reuse through follow-on implementation or related work. The 1.5325x figure is cumulative model input, not Loci response size; the v4 pair actually has fewer visible bytes and recorded MCP/shell operations, but more outer rounds. It does not isolate graph causality or establish downstream net value.

Vik then rejected selecting the Objective-acceptance task next and directed: "update the Manifest as you see fit with the above". Vik reframed Loci value around correct completion of useful work and total time/cache-aware cost across context-preserving continuations, including later calls avoided and rework prevented. Manifest now inserts W1.8.4.4.10.2 with five design/accounting/freeze/run/analysis children before final acceptance at .10.3. Next is W1.8.4.4.10.2.1, define episodes and success criteria. All 48 completed entities and historical failed gates remain unchanged; Objective open at48/54. No new experiment or implementation ran in this plan-only turn.

The accepted plan treats correct completed work as the primary outcome, with total time and cache-aware cost measuring efficiency; packet size, calls, rounds and delivery are explanatory metrics. Define representative episodes and independently check terminal artifacts/behavior, retaining context across realistic follow-ups. Choose numeric criteria, schedule and task coverage before new results; explain their prospective relationship to historical 1.25 guardrails without rewriting old failures.

W1.8.4.4.10.2.1 defines episodes and success criteria. .2.2 implements matched graph-on/off workflow and whole-episode accounting. .2.3 validates and publishes the first frozen campaign. .2.4 runs all scheduled first outcomes. .2.5 analyzes downstream payoff, correctness, rework, total time/cost and remaining uncertainty. Stable final-acceptance task moves to .10.3 and depends on analysis; explicit whole-Objective acceptance by Vik remains required.

The graph intervention is fixed by the experiment, never chosen by the agent; normal deterministic product behavior remains. Hold model, prompts, source, instructions, tool discovery and exposed workflow constant, define graph-off exactly and validate absence of enrichment. Isolate writable repository state per arm/episode with identical starting content; fresh context between episodes and retained context within them. Freeze condition-independent follow-on prompts/triggers or outcome-conditioned branches and stopping rules. Use explicit balanced order and source/provider cache policies, without cross-arm evidence leakage.

Sol/high fork-none read-only review identified source-state isolation and condition-independent continuations as material gaps. Primary adopted both before mutation, retaining the confirmations on whole-episode accounting, historical evidence and final acceptance. Main remains sole Manifest/Brain writer. Accounting source decomposition and actual campaign schedule remain incomplete; design/freeze/analysis have bounded planning. Negative or inconclusive results can finish the investigation; evidence-linked fixes or further campaigns get distinct tasks and no automatic loop is selected.

Live semantic readback verifies the five ordered children, dependencies, no added delivery completion, Implementation phase and unchanged 48 completed entities. Evidence: /Users/brummerv/loci/.manifest/objectives/obj_47c29425d32907d2bde961f1fd313970.json and .scratch/deterministic-graph-retrieval/measurement-reframe.md. Repository experiments/implementation remain paused; next is the benchmark design task, not acceptance.

## How We Use It

Use Loci when codebase navigation matters. Treat its current MCP read surface as
the freshness boundary for indexed repository context. A SessionStart hook can
report an existing cache or seed an uncached repository, but that startup state
is not proof that cached content is current.

Treat MCP storage as a client-registration and process boundary, not a tool-call
choice. Each host supplies one explicit absolute store root and namespace; the
server binds that identity immutably before opening stdio. Codex and Claude use
distinct roots and namespaces by default. Missing configuration,
cross-namespace reuse, unsafe or malformed identity state, and silent adoption
of a populated legacy root fail closed. Intentional sharing requires both hosts
to configure the same root and namespace explicitly; repository paths remain
the only storage-adjacent input on normal navigation tools.

Normal context retrieval runs graph policy deterministically. The agent supplies
its query or known anchors; Loci chooses supported calls, types, references and
imports under fixed work and output budgets. Exact source paging hydrates selected
source. There is no per-request intent, family, direction, hop or enable-graph
choice. Native endpoints, complete selected proof, freshness and explicit unknowns
remain required. Source locators do not establish prior issuance or delivery.

Legacy primitive and opt-in traversal tools are an explicit operator diagnostic
surface; their exact-neighbour contract remains contains-only. Unresolved or
unsupported observations never become guessed trusted edges. Actual native
receipts now establish the repaired host's complete binding proof, browser and
renderer controls, exact source paging and byte accounting. The selection policy
gives direct selected-anchor relationships priority over incidental ownership
expansion without increasing budgets or weakening proof.

The selected next repair now prioritizes one representative supported input-type
path per selected callable before ordinary family interleaving. Explicit pairs
retain precedence; one shared neighborhood allowance and accepted proof/packing
transitions preserve budgets and controls. Structural input-role evidence
excludes generic constraints and body annotations. Unsupported multiline and
ambiguous nested roles remain ordinary edges.

Normal retrieval and reads now issue deterministic 30-character handles for
exact continuation. A bounded per-repository cache retains the full canonical
locator and survives process restart. Only final emitted references are persisted.
Unknown or evicted handles require fresh retrieval; legacy encoded locators
remain readable. Exact repository/hash/extent/UTF8 and source-containment checks
remain. Handles are not authorization credentials and still require exact reuse.
